evidence: Production _typed_slot_assertions accepts anchored single-token subject / <=2-token object 'is a/an [kind|type of] X' declaratives; it refuses every multi-clause and multiword-NP item in the fixed set.

Production _asserted_relation_propositions DOES split clauses and accepts is_part_of / precedes / resembles surfaces, but refuses 'event is part of ceremony.' because its negation regex [a-z]n['’]?t matches the 'ent' of 'event'.
Production parsers never emit IS_A + relation facts from one multi-clause turn: the typed parser is anchored, and the relation parser has no IS_A family.

The scratch parser reproduced all 68 hand labels with all negation/hedge/question/malformed controls refused, direction preserved under permutation, and PRECEDES canonicalised across comes-before / follows / happens-after surfaces (see metrics). This is SPEC AGREEMENT with the authored grammar, not independent generalisation; the sealed pool (16 items, added after the parser was fixed, with unseen surface forms) is the only generalisation probe and is reported separately.

The unmodified typed-slot read adapter + fail-closed scorer picked the taught slot for taught subjects (including a multiword subject and a 0.8-confidence multi-clause fact) and returned None for untaught subject, disjoint options, unrelated subject, untrusted edge, wrong relation_type, missing type_label, and negated/hedged teaching surfaces.
inference: That a deterministic regex grammar implements human-like compositional interpretation is not established by 1.00 spec agreement; the sealed pool only tests surface forms, not spontaneous syntax or genuine semantic understanding.
That these results would transfer to unseen real-world vocabulary or spontaneous multi-clause prose is NOT measured: the lexicon and surfaces here are authored, deterministic and source-independent.
That a multi-clause parse written through KnowledgeIntake would preserve provenance on every emitted edge is NOT measured: no engine boot, no intake call and no cold reload were performed.
That compositional phrase facts improve any downstream TRA answer is NOT measured: no gate, harness or benchmark front was run.
The brain citation set motivates clause-wise binding and provenance-sensitive slots; it does not by itself validate this specific regex grammar as a neural analogue.

recommendation.rationale: The existing parse path already covers all single-clause declarative surfaces needed by the merged TRA slot write/read path. The measured scratch gain is confined to multi-clause and wider-NP surfaces; the read side already handles those facts once stamped, so the missing piece is a write-side provenance/cold-reload validation, not a new production parser or a widened gate. Any revisit must stay behind RAVANA_TRA_PHRASE=1 (default OFF), call the same intake and Provenance path, and change no trust threshold or C10 gate.
